buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-secondary text-secondary hover:bg-secondary/10 px-8 py-4 rounded-full transition-all

form.style: Multi-step registration. Clean white inputs with gold focus rings. Generous padding. Progress indicator.

images.description: A statue is reflected in a dark space (Krishna/Divine representation)
Mandala Jaali Texture, soft cream/gold lines

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout of marketing sections. Use Shadcn ONLY for interactive elements like the multi-step form, dialogs, and select dropdowns.
Implement bilingual support subtly: Devotional labels in Hindi, core headings English, form English.
All headings MUST use Cormorant Garamond. Body text uses Outfit. Ensure you import these from Google Fonts.
Implement the sticky nav with a 'Glassmorphism' style (#0B1C3D with blur). Include the 'Sound Toggle' icon (visual only).
Hero section: Use the deep royal blue background, layer the mandala texture over it with low opacity. Apply a warm gold glow effect around the text and image.
Ensure generous spacing: Use py-24 or py-32 for main sections.
Cards (for Katha themes/Schedule): Soft cream background, border border-[#D4AF37]/20, rounded-2xl.
Add to Calendar & Registration Form logic requires proper state management. Registration form is 8 steps, build a responsive wizard UI.
Include a Countdown Timer to 28 May 2026.
Admin Dashboard: Build a simple, clean table to view registrations using pure Shadcn.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='register-btn').
